footprint_definition: Square footprint of half-width 0.25 degrees (about 56 km N-S full width, 56*cos(lat) km E-W) centred on the site. Smaller than the Mars footprint because Earth analog field sites are typically a few tens of km across; terrain statistics are computed on a grid block-averaged to the MOLA 16 ppd cell size (~3.7 km, separately per axis) so they are comparable to the Mars values.
